summary:
Dated observations from public #4516 comments for FS-GG/.github#4745. The spec, scripts and raw evidence stay in Home custody; this record names their digests and copies none of them. Route decision: platform/shared-bounded-execution-route.

Governing spec: rev 11 r2, learn4745-finite-profile-spec-v11r2.md, sha256 ec0a031df68e287a304d638e33f8976b508431bdc99be010bf2dc4bc00043e73 (MANIFEST a0aacc57...). fdev admitted it in 6353209726 and Home raised no objection (6353262463). It supersedes rev 10 bfae7887... and errata E1-E4. Erratum E5 (6359587710) sets the slice to 6G/1280 and measures headroom against the slice.

Accepted on production, with gaps:
- A0 F1-F7 (6349889898): the non-root mapping 1000->428679; all capability sets 0; NoNewPrivs; seccomp equality plus a VSOCK probe; ustar custody with budget/type/count verdicts; ENOSPC; fail-closed BindsTo/ExecStop, including a kill while paused; cgroup retirement with no surviving payload process.
- Part B A1-A26 (6352661446): all 9 gates true, and every case matched its expected verdict. A26 showed the group read both ways (EACCES negative, then a positive read), which confirms R13.

Recorded gaps:
- learn-op-disconnected/1 is not implemented. Rev 11 removes it as notImplemented, but #4745's Done-when still requires disconnect evidence unless a scoped #4745 decision drops it.
- A24 is cooperative.
- Read I/O, inode count during an op and two-point identity sampling are unbounded.

2026-10-23 touch (6359587710, 6360031719, 6360174387). Admitted bytes:
- C3 r4 finalizer 7f875245...: retire_early; a timeout is reported as rejected:truncated, not budget; 32 MiB fadvise cadence.
- C2 r5b operator 318edb4e...: headroom 2.5 GiB / 576 tasks against the slice, plus a host MemAvailable >= 4 GiB guard. A 2-op cap is enforced by an exclusive O_NOFOLLOW|O_CLOEXEC flock, held through C2's exit with a 120 s bound. C2 refuses ('slice limits absent') unless the live slice shows memory.max 6442450944 and pids.max 1280.
- Slice drop-in d6f4f58d... and retirement-ack writer aadd55b1....
C1 r8b installed these at 07:44Z (daemonReloadRc 0, verify complete). The live slice read back memory.max 6442450944, pids.max 1280 and cpu.max 200000 100000.

Retirement-ack gate: an op whose retirement failed blocks later ops until it is acked by its exact record sha256 through the ack writer. A0 r4 passed 9/9 with failures == acked == [the one admitted id] and unacked == []. Any other unacked failure blocks and needs its own admission. After the root terminal expires, a future ack needs its own hash-pinned sudoers entry or a per-operation root step by the user.

Part B re-run on the installed bytes: Home reported harness r3b 3e74735d... PASSED 31/31 on production at 08:15Z, with all 10 gates true (6360587060; summary 0321a23d...). The report covers:
- A31: the live slice limits.
- A28/A28b: the operator killed mid-op and mid-precheck, still leaving complete retired records.
- A29: a third concurrent op refused.
- A30: the evidence-size refusal.
- A27/A27b: an unacked failure refused, and an acked one admitted.
fdev's independent acceptance of that run was still pending at capture, so treat it as reported, not accepted.

Still owed under #4745: step 5 cleanup, the standing operator sudoers entry, the reader-integration admission (spec §12: genuine installation inventory with production-input custody) and the learn-op-disconnected/1 evidence or a scoped decision. The A28 operator kill is not that evidence.

Limits: installed bytes, slice values and acks are live facts; re-read them on Home before action. LEARN acceptance establishes nothing for SC2. This record grants no operation.
title: LEARN Home finite profile: rev 11 r2 governs, A0-A26 accepted with gaps, C3 r4/C2 r5b installed with a retirement-ack gate
